info.name: Xeno
info.description: Organized collection for Xeno integrators. User APIs cover OpenAI-compatible and Ollama-compatible inference, Xeno Client covers the local dashboard API, and Xeno Server covers management and operations APIs.

item.name: User APIs
Ollama APIs

item.name: Xeno Client

request.description: Create or update a provider. shareWithNetwork false keeps the provider off the Xeno network (for example your own Ollama Cloud or ollama.com account) while this machine's local endpoint can still use it. routeLocalRequests lets the local endpoint answer requests with this provider directly. maxConcurrentRequests (1 to 256) limits network and local requests together across the provider's models; null inherits defaultMaxConcurrentRequests.

body.raw:
{
  "name": "{{localProviderName}}",
  "apiType": "Ollama",
  "endpoint": "{{localProviderEndpoint}}",
  "timeoutMs": 300000,
  "credential": null,
  "clearCredential": false,
  "allowModelManagement": true,
  "shareWithNetwork": true,
  "routeLocalRequests": true,
  "maxConcurrentRequests": null
}

request.description: Replace the local dashboard, local inference listener, and telemetry settings. Send the full localInferenceServer object, including routes, because omitted fields reset to their defaults. routingMode is PreferLocal, NetworkOnly, or LocalOnly. defaultMaxConcurrentRequests (1 to 256, default 4) applies to providers that set no limit. Listener host and port changes need a client restart.

Dismiss the one-time notice shown after the client moved the local inference listener from the pre-0.2.0 default port 11434 to 11435. Returns {"acknowledged": true}. The notice appears in GET /api/v1/state as connection.localInferencePortMigratedFrom and localInferencePortMigratedTo.

item.name: Local Routing
item.description: Where the Xeno Client local inference listener sends each model. Reads the listener's live provider health and counters when the client is running, edits per-model route rules in client.json, and pages the metadata-only local endpoint request log. Rule changes apply to the running listener without a restart.

request.description: Listener URL, routing mode, route rules, each local provider's health, load, and limit, and request counters since the listener started. runtimeAvailable is false when the client is not running, in which case health is unknown.

Where the listener would send {{modelName}}, and why. shape is openai (the /v1 routes) or ollama (the /api routes). Returns target, route (the X-Xeno-Route value), provider, a stable reason code, fallbackToNetwork, and shapeSupported.

Create or replace the rule for one model. target is Local (provider required) or Network. fallbackToNetwork lets a local request go to the network if the provider fails before responding; it never retries a response that already started. Set originalModel to rename an existing rule. Invalid rules return 400.
Remove the rule for a model; the model goes back to the default route. Returns 404 when there is no rule.
Probe every provider used for local requests now (Ollama /api/tags, others /v1/models) and return each one's health, latency, error, and discovered models.
Page the local endpoint request log, newest first. Metadata only: route, provider, status, timing, and token counts. Bodies are never stored.

item.name: Local Chat
item.description: Chat with local and Xeno network models through the running client (see archive/CHAT.md). Every request needs X-Xeno-Local-Token; the client writes the token to ~/.xeno/local-api.json while it runs.

request.description: Models available for chat: this machine's first, then the Xeno network's.
Xeno tools the chat model can use when a conversation has tools on, each marked read-only or not.
Connection state of each external MCP server in Chat.McpServers: name, transport, enabled, connected, tool count, and the error when not connected.
Connect to the configured external MCP servers again (after a settings change) and return their state.
Conversations, pinned first, then most recent.
Start a conversation. Save the returned Id as chatConversationId.
A conversation with its messages, tool calls, and ratings.
Change the title, model, system prompt, tools switch, or pin. Omitted fields stay as they are.
Send a message. The answer streams as server-sent events: turn, thinking, chunk, tool_call, error, usage, done.
Stop a running turn; what arrived is kept.
Allow or deny a tool call that changes something.
Rate an answer 1 (thumbs up) or -1 (thumbs down) with an optional comment. Rating again replaces it.
Remove an answer's rating.
Ratings, newest first.
Chat turns, newest first. route accepts local, network, or local:<provider>; rating 0 means unrated.
One turn with its tool calls.
Delete the turns matching the filters. Conversations are not affected.
Totals, percentiles, ratings, buckets, and a per-model breakdown.
